name: 83856 · Priest River, ID
findings: ZIP 83856 (Priest River) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83856 (Priest River) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
